_doc: M3-CRE-611: Haluna's ambient wildlife (WildlifeLayer zone_id ch02/haluna). Read from the dressed zone (2026-10-24): the sea stands at y 0.15 (WeatheringTide), the waterline is about 3.5 m inland of HalunaTerrain's shore line (x = 50 (|z|/210)^2), the tide wall's top is y 3.15 at x -26.9, the dock's tall posts and the net racks top out at 2.30 and 2.25, the beach houses' ridge ends at 6.1-6.45 and the stilt house's peak at 6.14. flocks: centre [x, z], radius_m (horizontal), altitude_m [lo, hi] (world y), perches [x, y, z, yaw_deg] (yaw 0 faces +z, 90 faces the sea at +x), every perch inside the radius. beaches: crab areas on the sand between the waterline and the dry beach, centre [x, z], half_extents [x, z], yaw_deg; ground heights from `ground` (a node path from the zone root and its height_at(x, z) method), else y. shoals: centre [x, y, z] in the shallows (0.3-0.5 m under the surface, 6-12 m offshore), radius_m, scale. swarms (M3-CRE-616): Haluna has no marsh or reed bed, so one dragonfly patrol hovers over the lagoon shallows' edge by the north crabs (the waterline runs about x -3 there, the sand at y ~0.35), centre [x, y, z] at about 1.2 m above the sand, radius_m, count. Re-seated on the dressed kit (the Act I audit, 2026-10-29: tools/creatures/wildlife_snap.gd and wildlife_audit.gd, which ray against the zone's visible meshes).
